Cross-check

  • ESB ecars: Official €0.60 AC / €0.72 DC (PAYG) = Irish EV Association €0.60/€0.72 and EV·Echo €0.73 contactless DC (2 Oct); Irish Times/Examiner quote the same 60c/72c.
  • IONITY: Official Go €0.77 = IEVA €0.77 and EV·Echo €0.77 app; direct/contactless €0.81 (secondary) is higher than the official minimum – hence 'from'.
  • ePower: Official eVeryday member rates €0.47 AC / €0.66 DC equal IEVA's subscriber figures; the PAYG AC €0.60 / DC €0.73 used for colour exist only in secondary sources.
  • Applegreen Electric: IEVA €0.73 (card) / €0.68 (app); EV·Echo €0.68 by card. 5c spread; official page gives no figure.
  • EZO: IEVA €0.63 AC / €0.74 DC (varies by host); EV·Echo ~74c DC, 63c AC, Lidl ≈50c. Official page: price per charger on map/app only.
  • Maxol Recharge: Only the IEVA table lists €0.75 DC; maxol.ie and the app give no public figure.
  • Circle K: Sources conflict: IEVA €0.69 vs EV·Echo/Irish Examiner €0.52–0.57 → not coloured.
  • Tesla: Per-site, time-of-day pricing; tesla.com not reachable by automation → unverified, grey.

Data gaps

No price anywhere (≥10 sites, 0 priced): GoCharge (193), Monta (184), (no operator tag) (152), Tesla (37), Weev (35), ChargePoint (26), Pinergy (26), GEV Top Up (23), EVBox (22), PlugSurfing (22), Go Platform Limited (20), Circle K (17), Stop N Top (17), Blink Charging (15), Smappee (13).

Unknown power: 191 of 2,184 sites (9%) have no kW tag – hidden by the power slider unless 'include unknown power' is ticked. Unknown AC/DC: 80 sites (4%) – no socket tags; they get no price even if the operator has one. No operator tag: 152 sites.

Coverage vs. official count: CSO (data.gov.ie PCIEV02, 2025, updated 2026-08-28) counts 1,125 public charging locations / 3,416 points; this map has 2,184 sites (OSM 1,221 + Open Charge Map-only 1,464; 1,143 OCM records merged into OSM sites). OSM is probably incomplete for ESB home-area/on-street points; open-data station lists (AFIR) are not yet public (below).

Dynamic data (live availability/price): not available – see sources card. Open Charge Map export is old (2026-04-22); a free API key (ie/.ocm_key) would give live data.

Excluded: OSM 33 (private/disused/bike-only {"private/disused": 29, "bike only": 4}); OCM 239 ({"not operational/planned/removed": 229, "private/restricted": 10}); 1 points outside the island polygon (Great Britain, Isle of Man). Northern Ireland: 500 sites shown only on request, GBP prices not converted.

Sources & licences

Stations: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL; Overpass API z.overpass-api.de / overpass.openstreetmap.fr – maps.mail.ru mirror returned 504 on 15 Oct) and Open Charge Map (CC BY 4.0, GitHub export; providers with NC/SA licences dropped). Republic/NI split: OSM boundary relation 62273; clustering 30 m, OCM merge 75 m.

Official open data checked: data.gov.ie / CSO PCIEV02 (aggregate counts only, CC BY 4.0 – used for the coverage cross-check). Ireland's AFIR National Access Point is data.gov.ie; TII's Data Exchange Platform (OCPI 2.2.1, static + dynamic data incl. tariffs) takes CPO registrations but no station-level public feed was found (15 Oct 2026) – re-check each refresh. ESB/SEAI publish no downloadable station list.

Prices: operator pages listed above; aggregators: Irish EV Association, EV·Echo, Irish Times (2 Sep 2026), Irish Examiner – secondary only. No API keys from other websites are used; oplaadpalen.nl and other restrictive-licence data are not used.

Prices are network list prices; actual price can vary by site, time of day, payment method and subscription. Time, access, connection and overstay fees are in popups/notes only. Errors in the source data can't be excluded.

Refresh: see emobility/ie/README.md (python3 ie/fetch_stations.py && python3 ie/build_ie.py).
